summary: Viant Technology Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a secondary offering of 8,500,000 Class A shares by a selling stockholder, with no proceeds to the issuer. An underwriters' 30-day option covers up to 1,275,000 additional shares from the company. Last reported Nasdaq price was $12.60 on September 15, 2026; pricing and underwriting discounts are blank. The offering raises the issuer's economic interest in Viant Technology LLC from 31.7% to roughly 44.5%, while the Vanderhooks retain over 50% voting control. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing and lock-up/overhang terms.
